questions.question: You accidentally spill coffee on your colleague's new shirt while working in the office. Which response is the most appropriate?
options: It's your fault, I didn't mean to do it.
I'm terribly sorry. Is there anything I can do to fix this?
Don't worry about it, it happens all the time.
I hope you don't mind, I was in a hurry.
questions.answer: I'm terribly sorry. Is there anything I can do to fix this?

questions.question: A friend asks for your opinion on a movie they are considering watching. Which response best expresses your opinion politely?
options: I don't like movies at all.
That film sounds absolutely terrible to me.
I've heard it's quite good, so I'd recommend giving it a try.
You should probably stay home and watch TV instead.
questions.answer: I've heard it's quite good, so I'd recommend giving it a try.

questions.question: Your manager asks you to take on an extra project before the weekend. Which response is the most professional and polite?
options: I can't do that. I'm too busy right now.
Sure, I'll do it. I don't mind.
That sounds like a lot of work. Can I discuss the details with you first?
Why did you ask me? I don't want to work late.
questions.answer: That sounds like a lot of work. Can I discuss the details with you first?

questions.question: You are at a formal dinner party and someone makes a joke that might be considered slightly offensive. How should you respond?
options: That was a very funny joke, I love it.
I think that was a bit insensitive, didn't you?
Oh, really? I thought it was quite clever.
Sorry, I didn't understand what you meant.
questions.answer: I think that was a bit insensitive, didn't you?

questions.question: A stranger asks for directions to a specific location in town. Which response is the most helpful and polite?
options: I don't know where that is.
Go straight and turn left.
Well, I'm not sure, but you could try going down that street.
It's too far to walk, you should take a taxi.
questions.answer: Well, I'm not sure, but you could try going down that street.
